How to Rank Your Brand on ChatGPT: Our Observations About Brand Visibility     

28 May 2025·Impulse Digital

In the Digital age, securing visibility is everything. Brands are constantly seeking to enhance their online presence by leveraging the best possible SEO practices available. For a long period of time, marketers have utilised SEO’s best tools, such as keyword ranking, on-page optimisation, and off-page optimisation to craft an effective strategy. However, with the advent of AI, its optimal usage is no longer in the shadows; rather, its presence can be fully optimised and integrated with SEO practices to yield the best results.      

ChatGPT, one of the popular AI platforms, has been extensively used as a medium to search, sometimes equating its usage to search engines. The platform is therefore considered essential for brands to establish their presence and enhance their visibility. In this blog, we will extensively present observations that can help your brand attain the much-needed presence on ChatGPT search.   

How can your Brand find visibility on ChatGPT’s search?

We will understand this by considering a hypothetical scenario, citing an example of one of the brands we cater to, a premium crane manufacturer, ElectroMech.   

  • Let’s say a customer/business is looking for an EOT Crane for their warehouse.    
  • Not limiting their research to word of mouth and search engine results, the customer looks up manufacturers on ChatGPT with a definitive prompt as showcased below: 

  • We can see ChatGPT offering several results computed in the form of content retrieved from various sources (articles or blogs) from various search engines. 

   

 

  • The column on the right shows the source article or blog from which information on each manufacturer ChatGPT is listed.   

  • ElectroMech ranked second in ChatGPT’s search results, owes its presence to the third-party blog, which has elaborated on its EOT crane’s efficiency and rated the brand as one of the top manufacturers in India.    

Observation

  • The results obtained from the ChatGPT search are data presented by analysing information on search engines.   
  • From an SEO perspective, ChatGPT offering ElectroMech in its search is attributed to the presence of ElectroMech’s content on lines of its product’s efficiency, versatility and experience on content platforms. This indicates that a way to achieve visibility on ChatGPT’s search resides in creating and presenting diverse content on websites or other content platforms, influencing search engine rankings for the brand.    

Recommendation

  • If you wish to rank the brand on ChatGPT’s search, a possible way to attain this is through your brand’s information presence on Google’s websites and other niche websites. The information can be shared through regular blogs, guest contributions, or paid guest posts.  

 

Conclusion

ChatGPT is an evolving platform backed by technology that implements minute variations and additions to it. These versions are largely shaped by a process of trial and error, guided by user insights and responses. With its integration with SEO practices, a plethora of opportunities open for marketers to discover the untapped potential in the digital spectrum.
